text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...A greater weight gain than anticipated.
I must immediately take measures to lose it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, there's no room in my current schedule.
In that case, the extracurricular lessons—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We look forward to working with you today, Sensei.
How is the microphone working for you?

text_block_list.name: Language Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I can hear you loud and clear.
Having class through a computer is quite a fresh and pleasant experience, too."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To secure time for exercise,
I would appreciate it if we could hold classes online for a while.
Naturally, I will not neglect my focus during lessons.

text_block_list.name: Language Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"‘Let's make sure to take frequent breaks.
Now then, picking up from where we left off—’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Daiichi Ruby switched all lessons that didn't require in-person attendance to online sessions. With this adjustment, her weight returned to normal.
